_doc: Per-page metadata for the Category-35 (Prepared and Packaged Meals) standard renderer (tools/build-category-standard-pages.mjs). Numbers come from data/standards/cat35-compiled/<record>.json (frozen derivations from the index repo's deterministic compiler, tools/standards/compile-cat35.mjs); nothing numeric is authored here. Only bone-broth is published here; the mixed-meals-prepared-foods and soups-broths-stocks rows are held pending the remediation session's HK/China occurrence-value tightenings and are intentionally NOT listed.

_meta.method_label: Composite read-across from the strictest applicable principal-component ML
_meta.methodology_version: Method v2.0 — government-limit default, composite read-across (CLAUDE.md Part 19)
method_prose: A composite food has no contaminant maximum level of its own — no government sets a heavy-metal ML for 'bone broth' or 'prepared meal.' The HMTc limit for each analyte is therefore a disclosed read-across from the strictest maximum level a credible government sets for the product's principal components, converted to the as-consumed basis. Credible regulators are the EU, Codex, US FDA, WHO/JECFA, FSANZ, Health Canada, the UK, and — for the terrestrial-animal-meat commodities that anchor an animal-bone stock — Hong Kong (Cap 132V). Occurrence never sets a value.

Bone broth is a long-simmered animal-bone and connective-tissue stock. Bone is the body's principal lead reservoir, and lead partitions from bone into the broth during prolonged, often acidulated simmering, so lead is the priority analyte and reads across the strictest credible animal-meat lead ML (FSANZ, 100 µg/kg) rather than a generic stock value; cadmium reads across the meat ML (EU, 50). Total mercury reads across the Hong Kong Cap 132V meat-of-animal mercury ML (50 µg/kg): terrestrial meat is not a mercury-bioaccumulation matrix, but a sovereign meat ML exists, so the cell is a disclosed read-across rather than an unbounded screen.

Where no credible regulator sets a component ML (nickel, tin, aluminium, total chromium) the analyte is held under mandatory control; the species cells (inorganic arsenic, methylmercury, hexavalent chromium) are substantiated not-material determinations bounded by their measured total. A fish-derived bone broth additionally inherits the Category 6 seafood ceilings.

pages.name: Bone broth
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified heavy-metal-safety standard for bone broth — long-simmered animal-bone and connective-tissue stock (Prepared and Packaged Meals), evaluated as consumed. Each limit is a disclosed read-across from the strictest credible-government maximum level for the product's principal animal components: lead 100 (FSANZ meat), cadmium 50 (EU meat), total mercury 50 (Hong Kong Cap 132V meat of animal). Where no government regulates a component the analyte is a mandatory control, and the species cells (inorganic arsenic, methylmercury, hexavalent chromium) are substantiated not-material determinations bounded by their measured total.

pages.name: Mixed and prepared meals (frozen dinners, boxed meals, ready-to-eat)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified heavy-metal-safety standard for mixed and prepared meals (frozen dinners, boxed meals, ready-to-eat) in Prepared and Packaged Meals, evaluated on as consumed / ready-to-eat (wet weight). A composite meal has no sovereign maximum of its own, so 6 of 11 panel analytes publish a disclosed read-across from the strictest applicable principal-component government maximum; the remainder are held under mandatory control or a substantiated not-material determination.

pages.name: Soups, broths and stocks
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified heavy-metal-safety standard for soups, broths and stocks in Prepared and Packaged Meals, evaluated on as consumed / ready-to-serve (reconstituted to serving strength; dry-mix and bouillon assessed as prepared, not as the concentrate). A composite meal has no sovereign maximum of its own, so 7 of 11 panel analytes publish a disclosed read-across from the strictest applicable principal-component government maximum; the remainder are held under mandatory control or a substantiated not-material determination.
